tutorials.title: Multiworld Setup Guide
tutorials.description: A guide to setting up Angband for Archipelago multiworld.
tutorials.text:
# Angband Multiworld Setup Guide

## Required Software

- A copy of the Archipelago-enabled Angband build (the patched `angband.exe` and
  its DLLs, from this repository).
- An Archipelago install (for generating/hosting), version 0.6.4 or newer.
- The `angband.apworld` installed into your Archipelago `custom_worlds` (or
  `worlds`) folder.

## Installing the apworld

1. Build/zip the `apworld/` folder into `angband.apworld` (a zip whose single top
   level folder matches the package name).
2. Drop `angband.apworld` into your Archipelago `custom_worlds` directory, or run
   it through the Archipelago Launcher's "Install APWorld" option.

## Creating a Config (.yaml)

Generate a template from the Archipelago Launcher ("Generate Template Options")
or the WebHost. Key options:

- **Artifacts As Checks** (default on): artifacts become Archipelago location
  checks and the multiworld hands out the real artifacts as items. Descending the
  dungeon then requires the "Progressive ... Artifact" items you receive. Turn
  this off for a pure unique-monster hunt with normal artifact drops.
- **Death Link**: when on, dying takes down everyone else who has Death Link on,
  and their deaths take you down too.

## Joining a Multiworld Game

1. Launch the patched Angband.
2. When prompted, enter the server address (`host:port`) and your slot name.
3. Play. Killing a unique monster sends that location's check; with Artifacts As
   Checks on, picking up an artifact does too. Received items are delivered to
   your home.

## What are the checks?

- **Unique monster kills** — every named unique you slay is a check.
- **Artifact pickups** (when Artifacts As Checks is enabled) — picking up each
  artifact is a check.

## Goal

Reach the bottom of the dungeon and slay Morgoth, Lord of Darkness.

readme.text:
# Angband 4.2.5

Angband is a graphical dungeon adventure game that uses textual characters to represent the walls and floors of a dungeon and the inhabitants therein, in the vein of games like NetHack and Rogue. If you need help in-game, press `?`. - **Installing Angband:** See the [Official Website](https://angband.github.io/angband/) or [compile it yourself](https://angband.readthedocs.io/en/latest/hacking/compiling.html). - **How to Play:** [The Angband Manual](https://angband.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) - **Getting Help:** [Angband Forums](https://angband.live/forums/) Enjoy! -- The Angband Dev Team

notes.text:
AP Angband 0.4.0 Release!

Changes since 0.3.0-
* Equipment Traits no longer locks the weapon slot, it instead adds an "Archipelago Sigil". This makes finding weapons more relevant and gives warriors less of a crummy early game.
* This means the Weapon Dice / Dice Count / Lightness are no longer applicable, and are replaced with some Extra Shot and Extra Blow traits. The weapon to-hit/dam still apply to your weapon.
* New consumables added to received items: Rod of Magic Mapping, Staff of Power, Staff of Healing, Staff of Holiness, Staff of the Magi
* Potion of *healing* added into filler
* Expanded Starting Shop Books shifted to Expanded Shops- Alchemist and Magic shops expand their offerings as well (Cure Crit potions and Potions of Healing, Wand of Fireballs, Staff of Dispel Evil, Wand of Annihilation)
* Pick of Erebor / Mattock of Nain fixed for 1:1 artifacts
* Fixed some general issues with racial traits, verified the Archipelago race should now work (haven't tried it myself, though)
